notes.note: Checked the Desktop CSP table and plugin-handler section against tauri.conf.json, lib.rs registration and html_reply_protocol.rs. Updated the frame-src row for station-html-reply: (and Wry's http alias under http:) and added the staged-reply handler paragraph: all-platform registration, 16 staged slots of about 8 MiB, staged bytes only, no network or credentials, shared label set, per-launch capability, top-frame guard and four-request limit, no response CSP on delivery, sandboxed empty refusals. Verified by the handler's Rust unit tests in a standalone harness; the real shells (WKWebView/WebView2/Android) are not exercised here.

Added the default html_preview then html_render route for chart/visual replies and the Artifact auth-token refusal fallback to the MCP tool servers section, matching station-orchestration-instructions.ts; regenerated station-docs-content.ts with docs:mcp:generate. Other claims in the section are unchanged.
